title: Composition (components in one process)
keywords: composition component components container composable intra-process load
text: Composable nodes are components loaded into a container process, with ros2 component load or ComposableNode in a launch file. Nodes in the same container can use intra-process communication, which avoids serialization and copies. ros2 component list shows the containers and their components. Composition changes performance, not the topic API: a component still talks to other processes over the middleware as usual.
